about: The rows of the mod GateKit AI: what the playing agent did, said, thought, looked at and noted. Added to GateKit's event log at start (GK.EventLog.Register).

ai.about: the playing agent's own record (GateKit AI): each step with its act, line and thought, each look, scene call, plan move and note

payload.target: what it was done to, as the answer names it
payload.way: fair, ordered or cheat: how the act goes (AI.Acts)
payload.say: the line shown over the head
payload.ticks: server ticks from the call to the answer
payload.chars: the length of the answer's now block as JSON text

payload.name: its name
payload.say: the line shown over its head, as shown (cut when too long)
payload.at: what the line is about: a uuid or { x, y, z }
what was pointed at: a uuid or { x, y, z }

payload.chars: the length of the answer's now block as JSON text

payload.name: the scene
payload.error: what it said when it did not

payload.prompt: the length of the owner's prompt
payload.promptFrom: the file the host read it from

payload.name: the plan
payload.steps: how many steps the plan has
payload.why: arrived (its condition came true) or done (its act was done)

payload.level: the level it was written on
payload.at: the point it was written at
